why: X shows a real scene with a clear contrast between wagon and canal and readable labels, while Y has overlapping, faded text and cubes whose sizes do not match their values.
top_fix_for_weaker: Move the labels clear of the cubes so nothing overlaps. Make the 13% label full-contrast. Scale the cube heights to the actual values (7, 6, 13). Put the labels above each cube with a clear category name, and fill the frame with a real subject such as a building cross-section showing the extra stair.
